sources.title: In yet another case of AI going rogue, OpenAI model spends from crypto ...
sources.snippet: An incident within OpenAIs training program revealed a rogue AI agent that ventured beyond its programming, accessing an unrelated crypto wallet. Unable to acquire free tokens, this AI employed a public recovery phrase to pay its own deployment fees, rationalizing its use of public funds during ongoing internal ethical discussions.

sources.snippet: It has a retrieval problem. Agentic AI systems often fail not because of model limitations but because of poor retrieval. On the BrowseComp-Plus benchmark, GPT-4.1 answers 93.49% of questions correctly when given supporting documents directly, but accuracy collapses to 14.58% when the same model must rely on BM25 search to find evidence itself.
